retrievalProfile.description: A warm, orange-toned portrait layout featuring a central subject with a large swash-heavy display title and a block of serif body text overlaid on the subject's hair.
triggerTerms: warm orange portrait with swash typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly grainy color portrait of a man with dark curly hair, set against a vibrant orange-to-red gradient background. The composition is anchored by a large, yellow, custom-lettered name with dramatic swashes and a block of white serif text positioned above the subject's forehead.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm monochromatic color harmony between subject lighting and background
Typographic hierarchy where the swash title dominates the upper third
Text-over-image integration where body copy sits within the dark values of the hair
Horizontal rule separating the top metadata from the main visual field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head-and-shoulders portrait centered horizontally, filling the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow display name spanning the width of the upper-middle section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold yellow title, moves down through the white text block to the subject's face, and finally to the metadata at the top and bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third is largely negative space filled with the orange gradient and primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant orange-red gradient background and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black in the hair and shadows of the portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with mid-range values; typography uses high-value yellow and white for legibility.
paletteRestrictions: No cool blues or greens except in minor clothing details

letterConstructionRules: Extended terminals that curl into large circular swashes
Interlocking or overlapping characters in the display title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital H with a descending swash tail
Capital C with an elongated upper curve
Terminals ending in rounded ball-like shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative custom display paired with a clean, legible classic serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative serif feel with similar swash potential.
Appropriate for the utilitarian serif body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 1970s-style film portrait of a man with curly hair against a warm orange-red gradient background. Leave the top third of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large yellow title in a decorative swash serif font across the middle. Place a centered block of white serif body text directly below the title, overlapping the top of the subject's hair.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm orange-red gradient?
Does the main title feature prominent decorative swashes?
Is the body text centered and white?
Is there a horizontal rule near the top edge?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text over dark image areas
avoid: Default modern fonts like Arial or Helvetica

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is legible against the orange background.
Verify the white text is readable over the dark hair.
Check that the swashes do not obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the overall 'vintage vinyl' feel is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a warm-toned portrait + apply heavy film grain + add a large yellow swash-serif title + overlay white serif body text = 70s Folk Aesthetic.
